test_load_external: test that py::module_local types registered in an external module can be loaded across modules
test_local_bindings: test that duplicate py::module_local class bindings work correctly across separate modules
test_stl_bind_local: test STL containers like LocalVec and LocalMap with module-local bindings across modules
test_mixed_local_global: test that local types take precedence over globally registered types in pybind11 modules
test_cross_module_calls: test cross-module function calls including inheritance casting and return value handling
